questions.prompt: Petero, gira vuba, dukwiriye kugenda ubu; abana baraza none
questions.answer: Peter hurry up; we must go now. The children are coming today.

questions.prompt: Nta bantu bari mu nzu. Nta cyo bitwaye. Ahari bari mu mirima yabo.
questions.answer: No people are in the house. Never mind. Perhaps they are in their gardens.

questions.prompt: Witonde, umugozi ni mugufi n'umukanara ni muremure
questions.answer: Be careful; the string is short and the belt is long.

questions.prompt: Ukwiriye guhagarara, nanjye ngiye kwicara
questions.answer: You must stand, and I am going to sit

questions.prompt: Petero, dukwiriye kugira vuba. Dukwiriye kwiruka, abakozi baraza
questions.answer: Peter we must hurry up. We must run; the workers are coming.

questions.prompt: Ngiye gusaba Maria imitsima itandatu, maze nkwiriye gucana umuriro.
questions.answer: Im going to ask Mary for six loaves of bread, and then I must light the fire.

questions.prompt: Witonde Petero, umwobo ni munini cyane
questions.answer: Be careful, Peter; the pit is very large.

questions.prompt: Bakwiriye gutangira gukora mu mirima none
questions.answer: They must begin to work in the garden today.

questions.prompt: Maria, nta bantu baje. Nta cyo bitwaye; ariko dukwiriye gushaka abandi
questions.answer: Mary, no people have come. Never mind; it doesn't matter, but we must look for others.

questions.prompt: Petero, mbese abahungu n'abakobwa bari mu nzu? Nta bo. Nta bantu bari mu nzu.
questions.answer: Peter, are the boys and girls in the house? No one. No one is in the house.

questions.prompt: Abana batoya barakina, ariko Petero na Maria ni bakuru. Bakwiriye gutangira umurimo.
questions.answer: The small children are playing, but Peter and Mary are grown up. They must begin to work.

questions.prompt: Maria uri he? Ndi hano. Na Petero, mbese ari mu nzu? Nta we. Ari he? Simbizi
questions.answer: Mary, where are you? I'm here. And Peter, is he in the house? No, he is not. Where is he? I don't know.

questions.prompt: Nta bantu baro hano. Ngiye kubashake. Ahari bari ku mugezi.
questions.answer: No people are here. I'm going to look for them. Perhaps they are at the stream.

questions.prompt: Uriya musaza mugufi arasaba abantu umutsima. Nta mutsima dufite, ariko turashaka gufasha uriya musaza.
questions.answer: That short old man is asking the people for bread. They dont have any bread, but we are wanting to help that old man.

questions.prompt: Ahari hari umutsima mu nzu ya Maria. Ngiye kubaza Maria.
questions.answer: Perhaps there is (some) bread in Mary's house. I'm going to ask Mary.

questions.prompt: Mbese Maria, ufite umutsima? Hanza har'umusaza mugufi. Arashaka umutsima.
questions.answer: Mary, do you have any bread? Outside there is a short old man. He is wanting some bread.

questions.prompt: Ababyeyi b'aba bana bari hanze. Ni byiza, ariko bakwiriye kuza mu nzu
questions.answer: The parents of these children are outside. That's fine, but they must come inside the house.

questions.prompt: Maria gira vuba; ukwiriye gucana umuriro, ariko ukwiriye kwitonda.
questions.answer: Mary, jurry. You must light the fire, but you must be careful.

questions.prompt: Petero, hagarara hano. Maria ukwiriye guhagarara mu muhanda.
questions.answer: Peter, stand here. Mary, you must stand in the road.
